text_block_list.text:
The first three years of the Twinkle 
Series. The 'Holy Sword' carved through 
the era. However...

Even that has now become a distant 
memory...
choice_data_list: Hey there, Durandal...

text_block_list.text:
All alone, I stood before my knight's 
monument. Even if the era forgets,
I never 
will.
choice_data_list: Hey there, Durandal...

text_block_list.text:
Looking back, she truly was a wonderful 
Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Demon Dragon, become a sacrifice for 
Villandry!
Always so dignified—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
As expected of my King.
Durandal is in awe 
of your profound insight.
Always humble—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I see the children smile... I 
always think to myself, these children 
truly are the treasures of our kingdom.
choice_data_list: Huh? Did I have a memory like this?

text_block_list.text:
...Whatever. Let's just pretend it 
happened. Always full of benevolence, 
and...
choice_data_list: Huh? Did something like this happen?

text_block_list.text:
"A truly perfect knight.
Flawless in every 
way... right?"

If only she were still with us now, how 
secure the kingdom would be.
choice_data_list: You have done well, Durandal...

text_block_list.text: (*glug, glug, glug...*)
choice_data_list: You have served well, Durandal...

text_block_list.text:
"Durandal,
I will never forget you. Never, 
for all eternity—"
Alright, cut!

And so,
the little play came to an end. We 
gave it our all, but...
choice_data_list: How was it? I gave it everything I...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My King, I thank you for granting my 
request.
choice_data_list: How was that? I did my best, but...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It truly is... delightful, isn't it? To 
still be held dear by the King,
even after 
departing.

Naturally, Durandal had no intention of 
going anywhere. She only put on this 
performance because she had been 
explicitly requested to do so.

It was in response to her wish:
"I want to 
be remembered and honored so much!" as a 
reward for working hard over three years.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Of course, it wasn't bad,
but if I'm being 
ambitious...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Your delivery is monotone! Your memory is 
hazy! And sometimes you sound like you're 
asking questions!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Could this be an area for improvement? As 
our King, I have faith you will overcome 
it in time.
choice_data_list: Overcome it...? We have to do that...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I would like to request this once a 
year. So that I may thoroughly reflect 
upon my work.
choice_data_list: Overcoming it...? We're doing it a...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Now then, O King, let us return to Tracen 
Academy. Come, this way.
choice_data_list: Over there? Isn't that the opposit...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Since we're here,
let's take a sightseeing 
detour through the town on our way back. 
Naturally—
choice_data_list: Over there? Isn't that the wrong d...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I, Durandal, shall guard you on your 
journey. Please rest assured.
choice_data_list: I-I wouldn't mind just heading str...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No... Even though it's such a rare 
opportunity... I'm sure the people were 
looking forward to it as well...
choice_data_list: I-I mean, going straight home woul...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
And here I thought this would finally
be a 
chance to fulfill my duty, too...
choice_data_list: O-Okay, got it. Then shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
As you command! That is so. That is truly 
my King!
choice_data_list: A-All right. Let's go, then.

text_block_list.text:
"Durandal loves escorting me...
or rather, 
she loves walking together with me. She 
always strides gallantly ahead—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My King, the way ahead is clear. Please 
proceed with peace of mind.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Please continue to entrust your
protection 
to me.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm counting on you!
Yeah, please do!

text_block_list.text:
Look at that smug face. Durandal looks so 
truly proud of herself when she's 
protecting me—
choice_data_list: Yeah, please!
Yeah, please!

text_block_list.text:
The march alongside my knight continues. 
Aiming ever onward, toward unfulfilled 
victory.
